⭐ Extremely Poor & Unprofessional Experience – Not Recommended
I am sharing my genuine experience with BS Auto to help common customers avoid unnecessary stress and loss.
I purchased 7 accessories for my Honda CB350 and prepaid the full amount in advance. Unfortunately, the experience turned out to be extremely disappointing.
My experience highlights:

1. Very unprofessional behavior – No proper coordination, no accountability, and no ownership of issues.

2. Excessive delivery delay – Took 10–20 days for delivery to Kolkata, which is completely unreasonable for paid accessories.

3. Misleading shipment updates – Some products were not shipped, yet the order status was marked as delivered. This created serious confusion and mistrust.
Advance payment taken, items missing – Full payment was collected upfront, but a few products were never delivered.

4. No Proof of Delivery (POD) – Even after repeated requests, POD was not shared on time.

5. Zero customer support – Calls are not answered, and WhatsApp messages and emails are ignored.

5. False assurances – Commitments were made verbally but not honoured.
Poor transparency – No clear information about how many items were shipped, through which courier, or when refunds would be processed.

6.Mentally exhausting follow-ups – Customers are forced to chase continuously for basic information that should be shared proactively.

Overall, the experience felt misleading and unfair to a common customer.

Final verdict:

If you value your money, time, and peace of mind, think twice before ordering from BS Auto. My experience was stressful, disappointing, and far from professional.
